mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained liquidity support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings declines, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic slowdown risks intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth below 0.5% annually in a supply-constrained regime signals impending recession, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturing slowdowns impact corporate margins.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 97.0 and supply-constrained regime conditions hold (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 230.0 signals persistent inflation that triggers Fed rate hike expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations face discount rate pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 230.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks accelerate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 850.0 thousand units signal weak consumer confidence and declining demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as residential sector weakness spreads to broader consumption.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 850.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 230.0 combined with FEDFUNDS below 0.5% signals inadequate monetary policy response to inflation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as inflation volatility erodes equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 230.0 and FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).
